rationale: VERIFY_TS / M14 JAD2-class. `calls` reduces a callee to a LEAF NAME by contract, and the pre-fix reducer took `callee.text` and filtered it with a DENYLIST of bad text (newline, backtick, `${`, brace-equals, >100 chars). A denylist enumerates the garbage someone has already seen. Measured over 32,672 call_expression nodes on 400 git-tracked corpus files the grammar produces TEN callee shapes — identifier 18,529, member_expression 14,030, parenthesized_expression 51, import 22, non_null_expression 11, super 10, await_expression 8, call_expression 6, subscript_expression 3, unary_expression 2 — and the two the reducer did not understand published their raw text as the target. Corpus evidence, pre-fix: `calls activate -> "!context.globalState.get"` (packages/vscode-typescript/src/extension.ts) and `calls watchFile -> "ensureDynamicPollingWatchFile()"` (tsc/testdata/fixtures/compiler/sys.ts), each alongside the CORRECT edge because the callee is a NAMED child and the recursion reaches it. Fix: calleeLeafName(), an ALLOWLIST that reduces through the decorator wrappers (non_null, parenthesized, unary, await, as, satisfies, type_assertion) and returns null for every shape that names nothing. A shape the grammar adds later now publishes nothing rather than publishing its text. Mutants: typescript/calls-callee-raw-text, typescript/calls-callee-no-reduction.
